entities.summary: Sisy Chen (b. 1958-03-25, Yilan County) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Yilan County and Taiwan. Known in the fields of taiwan, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
